change: Independent BIOS selection in Display & audio; validate on the session worker, then persist the URL for future game opens

behavior.menu: Display & audio / BIOS file / Browse BIOS / Load BIOS
behavior.validation: Readable unpacked local file, exactly 16384 bytes; no official BIOS hash is required
behavior.persistence: Existing version-1 LibraryProfile RMS record; save only after validation; failure retains previous preference
behavior.scope: Next Open game uses the saved path. Current machine, restart and state loading keep their existing BIOS. No ROM required to configure BIOS.
behavior.open_game: Successful OPEN remembers validated typed or browsed ROM/BIOS URLs. Browsing a BIOS alone does not persist unvalidated bytes.

validation.scope: Production controller/session/picker with host LCDUI/filesystem/RMS doubles; actual SDK compilation separately
